title: US Debt Is a National Security Issue, Haass Says
description:
Richard Haass, senior counselor with Centerview Partners, president emeritus for the Council on Foreign Relations, and former advisor to Colin Powell and President George H.W. Bush, says America's $40 trillion national debt, is not just a fiscal problem but a national security concern. He speaks with Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Money."
